notes: I ran 3 searches and 1 fetch. I found no 2025-26 population-genomics award that discloses both an award value and a genome count for short-read sequencing. I also found nothing on Ultima, Element, MGI or Roche winning one. Find-a-Tender returned 403 on a direct fetch, so everything below comes from search snippets. The Our Future Health awards (2022) were for genotyping arrays: Illumina Cambridge won the assay design and manufacture lot, Eurofins won the genotyping service, and the tender's estimated total was £212M. They are not sequencing and not a $/genome datapoint. The Genomics England Generation Study long-read tender (GEL-RE-25161, notice 060131-2025, award notice 26 Sep 2025) is long-read, so it falls outside the Illumina short-read thesis. A tender aggregator lists lot values of about £1.4M to £2.1M each. The winner and the genome count did not show in the snippets. A Poland population program (PLN 248M for 6-7k people, about $10k per genome) bundles far more than sequencing, so the $/genome is not usable. I did not search All of Us, Genome of Europe, PRECISE-SG100K or the Gulf programs. Those are the remaining unchecked parts of S609.
how_to_mine: Open Genomics England notice 060131-2025 in a browser or through a mirror such as tendertracker.co.uk or bwlgroup.co.uk to get the winner and value. For short-read programs, search press releases for 'Genome of Europe' (1+MG), PRECISE-SG100K, Emirati Genome Program, Saudi Genome and Qatar Precision Medicine. Look for a stated contract value plus a genome count. Check NIH RePORTER for All of Us Genome Center awards (OT2OD002748 and related) for annual funding, then divide by the genomes reported. In every case, check for bundled costs (sample prep, analysis, storage) before dividing.
new_candidates: Genomics England notice 060131-2025 (long-read Generation Study award, 26 Sep 2025): winner and value, via a mirror
Genome of Europe / 1+MG sequencing procurement on TED
Emirati Genome Program and Saudi Genome contracts with MGI or Illumina (vendor press releases)
